patch.value: Research and deliver the official frontend semantic catalog as one cohesive read-only WebSocket feature: version provenance, bounded theme summaries, category-scoped icons, and localized resources. Preserve generic ws call as the compatibility escape hatch and keep all live payloads private.
Add agent-native frontend semantic catalog discovery
Expose current official Home Assistant frontend version, theme, icon, and translation WebSocket contracts through typed, bounded, format-safe hassio commands while retaining raw ws call passthrough.

Typed commands cover frontend/get_version, frontend/get_themes, frontend/get_icons, and frontend/get_translations with input validation and bounded output; every command has detailed help and all six output formats remain valid; exact 100/100/100/100 source coverage and strict repository gates pass; read-only live acceptance passes against the configured Home Assistant instance without persisting private payloads
All-status duplicate search is clean for this scope; current official Core schemas and live instance support are confirmed; prior WebSocket lineages and repository conventions are understood.
Agents can discover version-specific visual semantics and localized labels without hand-authoring raw protocol payloads.
Improves deterministic planning, accessible presentation, localization, and forward-compatible automation generation.
A documented typed frontend discovery family with bounded machine-readable results and live proof.
Home Assistant removed translated action descriptions from get_services and current Core exposes dedicated icon and translation catalogs; the CLI lacks a discoverable typed surface.
